title: Serious AE must have at least one seriousness criterion = Yes (CORE-000022)
description: On the AE 'Serious?' field, when the form has seriousness-criteria fields (death, life-threatening, hospitalisation, disability, congenital anomaly, other medically important), add a check that a Serious = Yes answer has at least one criterion = Yes. Criteria are found by CDASH concept or name; each uses its own Yes code.
rationale: CDISC CORE-000022 (SDTMIG AE): AESER must be 'Y' when any seriousness criterion is 'Y', and a serious AE must carry its criteria. Catching the mismatch at entry avoids a submission-time conformance finding.

add_constraint.message: Serious AE: at least one seriousness criterion must be Yes.
